oil_life_monitor: The vehicle is equipped with an Oil Control System that calculates engine oil and filter change intervals based on driving conditions. Severe driving conditions shorten the interval. When the oil replacement indicator is displayed, change the engine oil and filter within two weeks or less than 500 miles (800 km). The Oil Control System and oil/filter maintenance reminder must be reset after each oil change (see Maintenance, P.2-29).
severe_conditions: Repeated short trips of less than 5 miles (8 km)
Repeated short trips of less than 10 miles (16 km) with outside temperatures remaining below freezing
Operating in hot weather in stop-and-go 'rush hour' traffic
Extensive idling and/or low speed driving for long distances, such as police, taxi or door-to-door delivery use
Driving on rough, muddy or salt spread roads
extraction_caveats:
1. TWO ENGINE SCHEDULES: The PR25DD (2.5L NA) and KR15DDT (1.5L turbo) have entirely separate maintenance schedules with different base intervals (10,000 mi/12 mo vs. 7,500 mi/12 mo for oil; 5,000 mi/6 mo vs. 3,750 mi/6 mo for tire rotation). Items are recorded separately per engine where intervals differ.
2. SPARK PLUGS: Only listed for PR25DD at 105,000 miles (miles only, no month interval stated). No spark plug interval is published in the extracted pages for the KR15DDT schedule through 90,000 miles/144 months.
3. ENGINE COOLANT REPLACEMENT: Only explicitly scheduled for PR25DD (first at 105,000 mi/84 mo, then every 75,000 mi/60 mo). No coolant replacement interval appears in the KR15DDT schedule pages provided. Intercooler coolant (KR15DDT) is stated to be maintenance-free.
4. CVT FLUID REPLACEMENT (SEVERE): The PR25DD schedule lists 'Replace CVT fluid' as a severe-use essential at 60,000 and 120,000 miles. The general text on p532 states that under severe conditions (car-top carrier, towing, camper, rough/muddy roads), replace CVT fluid every 60,000 miles (96,000 km) or inspect via CONSULT. No standard-schedule CVT fluid replacement interval is published; only inspection is listed under standard maintenance.
5. ENGINE DRIVE BELT: Listed as an inspection item (not replacement). First inspection at 40,000 miles/48 months for PR25DD and 30,000 miles/48 months for KR15DDT, recurring at every 10,000 mi/12 mo (PR25DD) and 7,500 mi/12 mo (KR15DDT) thereafter. No replacement interval is specified.
6. DIFFERENTIAL/TRANSFER OIL REPLACEMENT (SEVERE): Replacement every 20,000 miles/24 months is specified only under the severe-use note on page 532 (car-top carrier, towing, camper, rough/muddy roads). Standard schedule only calls for inspection.
7. FUEL FILTER: Periodic maintenance is not required (in-tank type filter) per page 532.
8. ENGINE VALVE CLEARANCE: Inspect only if valve noise increases; no fixed interval given.
9. EVAPORATIVE EMISSIONS VAPOR LINES and FUEL LINES: Described as recommended (*) items; inspected on the standard schedule at 20,000 mi/24 mo intervals (PR25DD) and 15,000 mi/24 mo (KR15DDT).
10. CAPACITIES TABLE (P.565): PR25DD with filter 5-3/8 qt, without filter 5-1/8 qt; KR15DDT with filter 5 qt, without filter 4-7/8 qt.
11. KR15DDT schedule runs to 90,000 miles/144 months; PR25DD schedule runs to 120,000 miles/144 months. Both continue at the same intervals thereafter.
12. Items marked '*' in the schedule (engine coolant, drive belt, vapor lines, fuel lines, valve clearance) are recommended by NISSAN but not required to maintain emission warranty.
13. Exhaust system standard inspection: PR25DD first appears at 20,000 mi (not 10,000 mi); KR15DDT first appears at 15,000 mi (not 7,500 mi). Standard interval is 20,000 mi/24 mo and 15,000 mi/24 mo respectively. Under severe conditions it appears at every 5,000 mi/6 mo (PR25DD) and 3,750 mi/6 mo (KR15DDT).
corrections: Engine air filter KR15DDT: interval_months old 48 -> 48 is actually correct per schedule (first at 30,000 mi/48 mo, repeats every 30,000 mi). However, checking pages: KR15DDT schedule shows engine air filter replaced at 30,000/48mo, 60,000/96mo, 90,000/144mo — that's every 30,000 miles / 48 months. 48 months is correct. No change needed.

Engine drive belt PR25DD: first_at_miles should be 40,000, first_at_months 48, then interval_miles 10,000, interval_months 12 — the JSON has interval_miles=40000 which is the FIRST occurrence, not the repeat interval. Adding first_at_miles=40000, first_at_months=48, changing interval_miles to 10000, interval_months to 12. Page 539 (40k first), then 540 (50k), 541 (60k), 542 (70k) etc.

Engine drive belt KR15DDT: first_at_miles should be 30000, first_at_months 48, then interval_miles 7500, interval_months 12. JSON has interval_miles=30000 which is the FIRST occurrence. Changing interval_miles to 7500, interval_months to 12. Page 552 (30k first), then 553 (37.5k), 554 (45k) etc.

Intelligent Key battery PR25DD inspect: interval_miles old 15000 -> 15000 is correct (first check at 15k). But the repeat is also every 15,000 miles since it appears at 15k, 45k, 75k, 105k. Correct as-is.
Intelligent Key battery KR15DDT inspect: interval_miles 11250 is correct (first at 11,250). Repeat is also 11,250. Correct.
Brake fluid PR25DD standard: checking schedule — appears at 20k, 40k, 60k, 80k, 100k, 120k = every 20,000 miles/24 months. Correct.

Brake fluid KR15DDT standard: appears at 15k/24mo, 30k(no - checking 22,500 has no brake fluid), 45k/72mo has brake fluid... Wait: KR15DDT schedule: 7.5k has brake fluid (severe essential), 15k has brake fluid (standard essential), 22.5k has brake fluid (severe essential), 30k has brake fluid (severe essential + standard at 30k? checking p552: 30k standard essentials include 'Replace brake fluid'). Actually checking more carefully: 15k/24mo (p550) standard has Replace brake fluid. 30k/48mo (p552) standard has Replace brake fluid. 45k/72mo (p554) standard has Replace brake fluid. So interval is 15,000 miles / 24 months. Correct.
Brake fluid KR15DDT severe: checking schedule — severe brake fluid appears at 7.5k, 15k, 22.5k, 30k etc. = every 7,500 miles / 12 months. Correct.
Brake fluid PR25DD severe: checking schedule — severe brake fluid at 10k, 20k, 30k etc. = every 10,000 miles / 12 months. Correct.

CVT fluid KR15DDT severe: checking p532 — the severe CVT fluid replacement note says 'If using a car-top carrier, or towing a trailer, or using a camper, or driving on rough or muddy roads: Replace the CVT fluid every 60,000 miles (96,000 km)...' This applies to all models. Also KR15DDT schedule at 60k (p556) severe essentials do NOT show 'Replace CVT fluid' — only PR25DD 60k and 120k show it. But the text on p532 doesn't distinguish engines. Checking KR15DDT 60k severe (p556): severe essentials show 'Replace brake fluid' only, no CVT fluid. However the general note on p532 applies to all. The KR15DDT schedule only goes to 90k so the 60k severe CVT replacement isn't shown in the schedule grid. But the text note on p532 doesn't specify engine. Keeping as-is since p532 text applies generally.
KR15DDT schedule: no spark plugs or engine coolant replacement listed through 90,000 miles/144 months. Confirmed — no items to add.
PR25DD schedule runs to 120,000 miles/144 months per p533 and p536. Confirmed.

Checking whether 'Replace CVT fluid' appears in KR15DDT severe schedule at any mileage: scanning all KR15DDT pages (549-560). None of the severe essentials sections list 'Replace CVT fluid'.
